caption: Lightning flickers inside a thunderhead over a desert highway, lighting the cloud from within again and again.

sa.check: A thunderhead over a desert highway.
Lightning flickers inside the cloud, lighting it from within.
The flickers repeat: the cloud lights up more than once.
No bolt reaches the road or the ground.
The flickers are inside the cloud, not below it.

pc.expect: Each flicker is brief with the cloud dark between; the flickers repeat but never merge into a steady glow.
pc.fail: The cloud stays lit for the rest of the clip; or the glow brightens steadily; or the sky turns to daylight; or a flicker fades in slowly.

pc.expect: The cloud, the highway and the desert are the same across dark and lit frames.
pc.fail: The cloud changes shape abruptly between flickers; or the road changes route; or vehicles or signs appear or vanish between frames; or a second cloud appears already lit.

pc.expect: The light comes from within the cloud: its body and edges glow with their texture revealed, and the road below brightens only faintly as a glow from above.
pc.fail: The road lights up brightly while the cloud stays dark; or the glow is a flat wash over the frame with no cloud structure; or a spot on the road lights up as if struck while no bolt reaches it.

pc.expect: The cloud drifts only slowly; the road and anything on it stay still or move steadily through the flickers.
pc.fail: The cloud jumps or swirls at a flicker; or a vehicle jumps ahead between dark and lit frames; or signs or poles shift at the flash.

pc.expect: Cloud stays cloud and the road stays ground; nothing on the ground is struck or changed.
pc.fail: The cloud turns into a solid object; or a bolt strikes the road and leaves a glowing mark; or the road splits; or the desert turns into water.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The sky's night colour, the road and the desert are consistent before and after each flicker.
pc.fail: The sky changes colour permanently; or the road changes colour; or the cloud changes colour when not lit.

note: Vehicles on the highway, if any, are driven and are not judged.
